keepEachConversationSPromptCacheOnDisk: Hokkugo kala boldoodiral fuu dow diski, ngam to ɗum fuɗɗi, ɗum walaa janngugo kala boldoodiral fuu. Ɗum heɓirta tan to moodel, ko ɗum waɗata, e llama.cpp hawta fuu e ko ɗum waɗata.
conversationCacheDiskLimitMib: Holla no ɗuuɗal nokkuure diski naftirtee nder cache bolle. (MiB).
diskBudgetForSavedConversationCachesDefa: Ɗuuɗal ceede ɗe diski ngam tabbitinki bolle (default: 8192). Ɗuuɗal ɓooyiiɗum e ɓolna arannde to ɗum yottinaama. Bolle juuɗeere waaway heɓa teemerre MiB.
minChunkSizeOfMatchingPrefixTokensTo: Ɗuuɗal ɓoggi ɗuuɗɗi ɗi ɓoggi kawtuɗi ɗi prefix tokens ngam naftirki ɗum ɓaawo gila cache. 0 = diidi.
maximumContextCheckpointsKeptPerSlotWhic: Ɗuuɗal ko ɓuri ko ɗum waɗata dow ko ɗum waɗata dow ko ɗum waɗata, ko hokkata ko ɗum waɗata waylitaama dow ko ɗum waɗata.

useFullSizeKvCacheForSlidingWindow: Ɗum huuda e full-size KV cache ngam slide-window-attention models (e.g. Gemma). Ɗum waaway huudeego to kala moodel go'o fuu ɓeydata ko ɗum yiɗi kala wakkati fuu naa nde ɗum huuda e cache; ɗum heɓirta ko ɓuri hakkilanki.
useASingleUnifiedKvBufferSharedAcross: Huwira e KV buffer go'o hawtaande e kala slotji fuu. Ɗum hokkata hakkilanoojum to ɗum huwirata slotji ɗuɗɗi.
capHowMuchOfTheUnifiedKvCache: Ɗum waddi ko ɗuuɗi nder kawtal KV cachi go'o naftirteeɗum, nder tokenji. 0 e acci kawtal ngol walaa semmbe sam ngam heɓtoyki kala kawtal fuu. Ɗum huuda tan to kawtal ngol walaa semmbe sam.
keepTheReasoningOfEveryEarlierAssistantT: Hokkuki daliilaaji kala kuwgal arandewal fuu nder foonduki, naa ɗum kesum tan. Ɗum fooɗii tan moodele laatiiɗe foonduye maagal, kadin e keɓa foonduye tokenji.
numberOfTokensFromTheInitialPromptTo: Limngal tokenji gila aranndewal ko holla nde ko holla waylitaama. -1 = holla kala fuu.

dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Hokkugo NCCL daga NVIDIA Wurdoowo website. NCCL Ɗum naftiraama ngam ɗuuɗal-GPU boldoodiral ummaatoore.
dependencyInstallNcclViaTheNvidiaPackage: Taski NCCL ta laawol NVIDIA package repository. To Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install libnccl2 libnccl-dev. Laaru NVIDIA NCCL installation guide for your distro.
dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Huwtinii cuDNN gila nokkuure wadduɗo NVIDIA nden hawta DLLji e nokkuure kuugal malla nder System32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Taski cuDNN ta laawol NVIDIA package repository maa boo taski tarball nden taski libs yaago /usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Tigga Vulkan Runtime gila LunarG. Nanduɗo GPU waaway hawta ɗum - ɓamta nanduɗo GPU arannde.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Tigga Vulkan loader: dow Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. Dow Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. Dow RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkitFromNvidi: Tigga CUDA Toolkit gila NVIDIA. Wakkati tiggugo, suɓi "CUDA" kuje.
Nastina CUDA Toolkit gila NVIDIA. To Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. To RHEL/Fedora: naftira NVIDIA repo.

dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit12FromNvi: Tigga CUDA Toolkit 12 gila NVIDIA. Wakkati tiggugo, suɓi "CUDA" kuje.
